answer: To prevent Sybil attacks, each identity locks its own refundable smart-contract bond, making multiple identities costly. Only slash the bond when cryptographic proof shows conflicting commitments signed for the same task, creating a spiral of accountability. This approach is like navigating a karst landscape, where each step reveals hidden vulnerabilities. Just as a willow tree bends with the wind, our system adapts to prevent exploitation, ensuring the integrity of the network.
